name: Fire Detection & Alarm — device test then cause-and-effect once interfaces are live

activities: coordination with ceilings/walls for device positions
install FACP, repeater panels, power supplies and standby batteries, network cards
mount and address detectors, MCPs, sounders/beacons, interface modules, door holders
loop integrity, insulation and earth-fault checks
sounder SPL/audibility survey and visual-alarm coverage
verify cause-and-effect matrix: detection to HVAC shutdown, smoke control/dampers, AHU trip, lift homing, door/mag-lock release, suppression release, fireman's interface, BMS signalling
interface to BMS, lifts, access control, HVAC, suppression, voice alarm/PA

typical_relationships.before: FACP location and fire-rated containment ready
typical_relationships.reason: loops run on the fire-rated route back to the panel location
devices land on the roughed-in wiring at each position
each detector/MCP is tested in place once addressed
the loop needs a powered panel to drive and monitor it
the matrix builds on proven inputs before verifying outputs

typical_relationships.before: interfacing systems live (HVAC, dampers, lifts, doors, suppression)
typical_relationships.reason: outputs cannot be proven until the systems they trip are installed and controllable
the authority witnesses a fully working, verified system

interfaces.requirement: fire-rated loop cabling on dedicated/fire-rated containment
cause-and-effect shutdown/smoke control requires HVAC and dampers installed and controllable
fire-to-BMS signalling and smoke-control interface must be live
fireman's lift homing/recall interface must be wired and testable
detection releases suppression and monitors sprinkler flow/valve status
FACP power and shunt-trip/shutdown interfaces to switchgear; standby power
door release/mag-lock drop on alarm for egress

testing_requirements: Loop insulation, continuity, earth-fault and short-circuit isolator test
Sounder SPL/audibility survey and visual-alarm coverage
Battery standby and alarm-load duration test
Interface/integration tests (HVAC, lifts, dampers, doors, suppression, BMS)
commissioning_dependencies: All interfacing systems installed and controllable (HVAC, dampers, lifts, doors, suppression)
Architectural finishes/ceilings sufficiently complete for device coverage
AHJ availability for the witness test
typical_exceptions: Aspirating (VESDA) adds pipework install, transport-time and hole-sensitivity calibration
Wireless fire systems reduce containment scope
evidence: Cause-and-effect commissioning was scheduled before the HVAC dampers, lifts and door interfaces it must trip were installed and controllable, and the sounder-audibility and battery-standby-duration tests were absent from the test plan.
